metadata.title: Analysis code for: The rheumatic pain care cascade across seven ageing cohorts
metadata.description: Python and R code for a cross-national analysis of the rheumatic pain care cascade (pain to diagnosis to treatment) in seven harmonised ageing cohorts: CHARLS, ELSA, HRS, KLoSA, LASI, MHAS and SHARE. The repository contains the cascade construction, weighted and age-standardised rates with cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals, cohort-specific logistic models pooled with DerSimonian-Laird random effects, functional-outcome models, the CHARLS wave 6 validation of incident diagnosis, sensitivity analyses, and the three figure scripts. No respondent-level data are included. Source repository: https://github.com/morrosun/oope02-rheumatic-pain-cascade (tag v1.0.0).
